## Structured parts, hardware, materials, and tools

| Type | Quantity | Item | Required condition |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Board | 1 | 610 x 457 x 18 mm structural board | Birch plywood preferred; finish fully cured and flat |
| Locator | 4 + 2 spares | 6 x 20 mm precision dowel pins | Final selection comes from the matching 00A/00B coupons |
| Anchor | 9 + 3 spares | M4 board threaded interfaces | Bore follows the chosen anchor maker and scrap-board test, not the template circle diameter |
| Adhesive | Small kit | Slow-cure structural epoxy | Locator pins only; use after the complete dry fit passes |
| Finish | As required | Selected board sealer/finish and applicators | Record product, batch, coat/application times, and manufacturer full-cure requirement; apply equally to both faces and every edge |
| PPE | 1 set | Finish-rated gloves, eye protection, and ventilation | Follow the selected finish SDS; keep the curing board away from ignition and contamination sources |
| Tool | 1 set | Hand-drill depth-control set | Locator bores are blind; prevent underside breakout |
| Layout | 1 set | Flat assembly surface, transparent tape, low-stretch board tape, sharp awl or transfer punch, steel rule, and long straightedge | For a tiled guide, overlap adjacent sheets by the printed 12 mm amount and match registration IDs; never butt paper or printer margins |
| Support | 6 | Board feet | Install after drilling; keep clear of anchors, reinforcement, and clamp load paths |
